motions.motion: Board Member Wright moved to approve the June 20, 2023 minutes. Board Member Love seconded the motion.
motions.headline: June minutes approved
motions.summary: The agency board approved the written record of its June 20, 2023 meeting.
motions.impact: Housekeeping for the agency's own files. Nothing here reaches a resident.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, approving an Interloca…
motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, approving an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Eagle Mountain City for the collection and remittance of incremental property taxes collected from property within the Sweetwater Industrial Park Community Reinvestment Area #3. Board Member Love seconded the motion. The motion passed with o unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Sweetwater tax increment routed to the agency
motions.summary: The agency board signed an agreement with the city setting how property taxes from the Sweetwater Industrial Park reinvestment area are collected and passed to the agency.
motions.impact: Money already collected in that industrial area moves between two sets of books. Nobody pays a new amount, and nothing on the ground changes because of this vote.

motions.summary: The agency board approved a participation agreement with QTS Eagle Mountain I, LLC, for a project inside one of the city's community reinvestment areas.
